subject: general
question: Muhammad Yunus was awarded Nobel Peace Prize for pioneering work in the field of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**microfinance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Muhammad Yunus** is a Bangladeshi social entrepreneur, banker, economist, and civil society leader.
 
• He is the founder of **Grameen Bank**, which was established to provide microloans to the impoverished without requiring collateral.
 
• Yunus's work in microfinance has had a significant impact on poverty reduction and has empowered many impoverished individuals, especially women, to become financially independent.
 
• In recognition of his efforts, Muhammad Yunus and Grameen Bank jointly received the **Nobel Peace Prize in 2006** for their efforts to create economic and social development from below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microfinance**

 
 
• Microfinance is a type of banking service provided to unemployed or low-income individuals or groups who otherwise would have no other access to financial services.
 
• It includes microcredit (small loans), savings accounts, insurance, and other financial products targeted at the poor.
 
• The goal of microfinance is to give low-income people an opportunity to become self-sufficient by providing a means to save money, borrow money, and obtain insurance.
 
• Microfinance institutions (MFIs) often operate in developing countries, where they serve as an important tool for economic development.
 
 
 
• **Grameen Bank**
 
 
• Founded by Muhammad Yunus in 1983 in Bangladesh.
 
• Grameen Bank's approach is based on the idea that the poor have skills that remain underutilized.
 
• The bank provides loans without requiring collateral, relying instead on a system of solidarity lending where groups of borrowers collectively guarantee repayment.
 
• It has been widely recognized for its innovative approach to providing financial services to the poor and has inspired similar initiatives worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Nobel Peace Prize**
 
 
• The Nobel Peace Prize is one of the five Nobel Prizes established by the will of Alfred Nobel, the inventor of dynamite, in 1895.
 
• It is awarded annually to individuals or groups who have made significant contributions to peace.
 
• Muhammad Yunus and Grameen Bank received the prize in 2006 for their efforts to create economic and social development from below.
 
• The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded by the Norwegian Nobel Committee, which is selected by the Norwegian Parliament (Storting).
